key_insight: NeoResearch combines literature mining and experimental memory to autonomously discover lightweight, domain-specific time-series forecasting models.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets reduced manual effort in forecasting architecture design and training optimization while retaining links between design choices, source evidence, and experimental outcomes.
method: Mine scientific literature for modeling mechanisms, empirical evidence, and applicability conditions.
Couple hypothesis-driven architecture exploration with iterative training and hyperparameter optimization in a dual-loop workflow.
Use hierarchical memory to connect literature findings with experimental outcomes and reuse conditional lessons across tasks.
evidence_signal: Experiments on ten datasets report competitive performance and support the dual-loop workflow, literature extraction, and memory reuse; the abstract provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Literature-derived mechanisms and reused experimental lessons require task-specific validation because their applicability depends on domain assumptions.
paper_title: NeoResearch: Literature- and Experience-Guided Autonomous Time Series Model Discovery
